short_description.database_value:
Autodesk, Inc. is a prominent American software corporation based in San Francisco, California. Founded in 1982, the company has grown from a developer of AutoCAD into a leader in design, engineering, and entertainment software. Autodesk is publicly traded on NASDAQ under the ticker symbol ADSK and is part of the NASDAQ-100 and S&P 500 indices. With around 15,300 employees, Autodesk serves over 100 million users globally.

The company focuses on three main sectors: Architecture, Engineering, and Construction (AEC); Product Design and Manufacturing; and Media and Entertainment. Autodesk offers a wide range of cloud-based services and software solutions, including tools for real-time collaboration, generative design using AI, digital prototyping, and sustainable design. Its flagship products include AutoCAD, Revit, Fusion 360, and Maya, which are essential for professionals in various fields such as architecture, engineering, and film production. Autodesk also supports education and nonprofit initiatives by providing free access to its software, fostering creativity and innovation.
